cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this your hands-on tutorial on building containers with Amazon ECS.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 Amazon ECS 容器實作。

cues.en: So first thing first, as a reminder, Amazon ECS is a managed container orchestration service used to run and scale machine learning model containers in production.
cues.zh: 提醒，ECS 是受管容器協調服務，用於正式環境執行與擴展模型容器。

cues.en: And what is the usual workflow?
What are the steps?
Well, first you're gonna store your image in ECR, as we just saw in the previous tutorial.
cues.zh: 先像上一堂，將映像存 ECR。

cues.en: Well, we created a repository in ECR, but inside this repository is where you can store the images.
cues.zh: 剛建了儲存庫，裡面能放映像。

cues.en: Then in step two, you're gonna create a task definition where you will define, you know, the container settings.
cues.zh: 第二步建 Task definition，定義容器設定。

cues.en: And then finally, in step three, after creating the task definition, you will run a service, which is where ECS will launch and manage your containers defined by the task
cues.zh: 第三步執行服務，ECS 啟動、管理任務定義的容器，

cues.en: using Fargate or EC2.
And you will see that Fargate is the by default choice to run your containers.
And then as an option, you can add some EC2 instances or instances from a hardware.
cues.zh: 也能選 EC2 或自有硬體的執行個體。

cues.en: Alright, so here we go.
Let's go into the search bar and let's enter ECS, the Elastic Container Service, which is a highly secure, reliable, and scalable way of running containers.
cues.zh: 搜尋 ECS，Elastic Container Service，安全、可靠、可擴展的容器執行方式。

cues.en: Okay, so welcome to Amazon Elastic Container Service.
Remember that it is fully managed containers and that it is a highly scalable and fast container management service that makes it easy to run, stop, and manage containers on a cluster.
cues.zh: 全受管、可擴展、快速的容器管理服務，輕鬆在叢集執行、停止、管理容器。

cues.en: Okay, so let's get started.
Let's click this button.
And we won't create any cluster here.
We will just do the step two of the usual workflow I was just explaining, which is, remember, to create a task definition.
cues.zh: 只做一般流程第二步，建立任務定義。

cues.en: So we're gonna go to task definition here.
And there we go.
This is what I'm gonna show you for this demo.
We're gonna create a new task definition, which, remember, comes after the first step of the ECS container workflow, meaning after you store the image in ECR.
cues.zh: 建立新的 Task definition，記得在 ECR 存映像之後。

cues.en: Okay, so first we have to give a name to the task definition family.
And since we're doing this for machinery deployment, well, I'm gonna call this Machine-Learning Deployment, okay?
cues.zh: 為機器學習部署，所以叫 machine-learning-deployment。

cues.en: Machinery deployment.
Then, infrastructure requirements.
So remember this, and I mentioned it in the workflow, the compute service of AWS that is usually used for containers is indeed AWS Fargate.
cues.zh: 記得流程提到，容器常用的 AWS 運算服務是 Fargate。

cues.en: By default, it'll automatically be AWS Fargate, which is, remember this as well, serverless.
cues.zh: 預設自動是 Fargate，也要記住，是無伺服器。

cues.en: But as an option, you can also add some managed instances coming from your own hardware or you can use also some Amazon EC2 instances, okay?
cues.zh: 也可加入受管執行個體、自有硬體，或 EC2。

cues.en: So we're gonna keep AWS Fargate.
Then, you can choose the configuration of your operating system.
So here we have Linux X86_64, but you can also use Windows, Windows-Server, and, well, that's it, okay?
cues.zh: 這裡 Linux X86_64，也可 Windows、Windows Server，等等。

cues.en: So let's keep Linux.
You can choose how many virtual CPUs you want to have.
Let's choose actually the minimum because it's a demo.
Memory, same.
Let's choose the minimum, one gigabyte.
And task roll, which will allow your containers in the task definition to make API requests to other AWS services, just how IAM roles work.
cues.zh: Task role 讓任務容器可向其他 AWS 服務發 API 請求，像 IAM 角色。

cues.en: Then, you also have a task execution role.
And, indeed, we'll have to create a new role in order for this to work.
cues.zh: 需要建立新角色才能運作。

cues.en: Otherwise, you won't be able to create your task definition.
cues.zh: 否則無法建立任務定義。

cues.en: And there you go.
Here, that's where you configure your container.
And so here we first have to give a name.
I'm gonna call it simply ml-container, okay?
Ml-container.
Then here, very important, as mentioned in the workflow, that's where you're gonna link the image that you have in your ECR repository to your ECS container.
cues.zh: 非常重要，這裡將 ECR 映像連到 ECS 容器。

cues.en: And so of course to find it, you would browse your ECR images.
Here, of course, we don't have any because we didn't create any in the previous hands-on tutorial on ECR, but that's where you would select it, okay?
cues.zh: 目前沒有，上一堂沒真的建映像，但會在這裡選。

cues.en: You select it and that's how you link your image in ECR to your ECS container.
cues.zh: 選取，就將 ECR 映像連到 ECS。

cues.en: Alright?
Then here you can configure the port mappings, but actually it's already configured with the right protocol.
cues.zh: Port mappings 可設定，這裡協定已正確。

cues.en: And then you have other configurations like the resource allocation limits and the environment variables.
cues.zh: 其他設定包括資源分配上限、環境變數。

cues.en: You can add some environment variable and some environment file.
cues.zh: 可加環境變數與環境檔案。

cues.en: And here you have the log collection that you can use from CloudWatch and some other optional configurations like the storage, monitoring
cues.zh: CloudWatch 日誌收集，以及其他選用設定，例如儲存、監控，

cues.en: or the text if you wanna organize better your task definitions.
cues.zh: 或標籤，方便整理任務定義。

cues.en: Alright?
And then finally, you would click Create, but, of course, if I do this, this won't work because I didn't indeed include an image here.
cues.zh: 最後按 Create，但我現在按不會成功，因為未填映像。

cues.en: But anyway, what matters here is to understand the process, the workflow that I mentioned at the beginning of this tutorial, and that will be way enough to enter correctly any ECR/ECS related questions
cues.zh: 重點是理解開頭工作流程，足以回答 ECR／ECS 相關考題，

cues.en: at the exam.
Okay, so I'm going to cancel this.
Now we have one final container service to cover, which will be in the next hands-on tutorial and which will be, of course, on EKS, Elastic Kubernetes Service.
cues.zh: 最後一個容器服務，下一堂 EKS，Elastic Kubernetes Service。

cues.en: So I look forward to seeing you there.
And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
